## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 -I tools/validate.py packs/<id>` prints `OK`
- [ ] The wallpaper, icons and videos are my own work (or I have the right to share them); no copyrighted characters or logos
- [ ] Text is readable on Home and in Settings
- [ ] `author` (and `github`) in theme.json are how I want to be credited
- [ ] Updating an existing theme: `version` is raised
